banner.description: White reference-format header with exact Tsinghua calligraphy and horizontally arranged Huawei geometry. All visible marks and text are vector paths.

tsinghua_emblem.derivation: Original official emblem vector path; preserved geometry and SVG color.

tsinghua_calligraphy.derivation: Exact four-character calligraphy compound path extracted from the cover. White reverse-version fill set to the emblem purple #85448f for the white background. No substitute font, tracing or generated lettering.

huawei.derivation: Original flower path, official gradient and six wordmark glyphs arranged horizontally. Uniform component scaling preserves the exact paths and aspect ratios.

typography.english_caption: TSINGHUA UNIVERSITY in one line, DejaVu Sans Bold converted to paths
typography.project_name: SignDuplex, DejaVu Sans Bold converted to paths

preserved_layout.method: Uniform font-size adjustment preserves the original text widths; center positions and baselines are unchanged.
